Subject: Your cheque bounce matter - CC/239/2019

Dear Ms. Chatterjee,

Thank you for meeting us on 9 February 2020 about your dispute with Aravali Textiles Pvt Ltd. As we understand it, the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction. The matter is listed before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Warangal.

Our advice is to argue that a stop-payment instruction does not protect the drawer when the debt is admitted. Please collect the written acknowledgement of the debt and the stop-payment memo and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of 35.7 lakh rupees.

Regards,
Adv. Kunal Bhagat

spans.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Warangal
